title: Palmeiras defeats São Paulo and extends unbeaten streak in Choque-Rei
seoTitle: Palmeiras defeats São Paulo and extends unbeaten streak
subtitle: The classic ends with a 'Verdão' victory and historical records
excerpt: Palmeiras defeated São Paulo 2-0 in the Brasileirão's 27th round, extending their unbeaten run and setting a new Choque-Rei record.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The classic match between Palmeiras and São Paulo, played at Nubank Parque, ended with a 2-0 'Verdão' victory, extending the Tricolor's unbeaten streak and breaking historical Choque-Rei records.

Unbeaten Streak Extended in Brasileirão

With the victory, Palmeiras reached 13 unbeaten matches against São Paulo, the club's best recorded sequence in the entire rivalry. The 'Verdão' also maintained the best positive streak in the classic, with seven consecutive wins, surpassing three other historical sequences.

Players and Tactical Decisions

Striker Jonathan Calleri, who was not yet 100% physically due to an ankle injury, remained on the bench for the game. The coaching staff, led by Abel Ferreira, decided to rest him due to his long-term situation and his upcoming suspension for the next encounter against the Tricolor.

São Paulo's coach Dorival Júnior also rested Calleri after the match against Boca Juniors, justifying the decision as a precaution for the injury and the risk of aggravating the situation.

Lineup and Match Progression

São Paulo started the match with a reserve squad, maintaining balance in the first half. The situation changed in the 37th minute when Osório was sent off after a VAR review for a hard tackle on Piquerez. With one less player, Palmeiras opened the scoring in the 45th minute with Murilo, and Vitor Roque extended the lead early in the second half, sealing the victory.

Impact on the Championship and Sudamericana

The triumph left Palmeiras with 56 points, maintaining their Brasileirão lead with a two-point advantage over Flamengo. The 'Verdão' continues to stand out in the competition, while São Paulo remains in 10th position with 33 points.

Furthermore, the result keeps the Tricolor focused on the Sudamericana final against Boca Juniors next Tuesday. São Paulo needs to win by a two-goal difference to advance directly to the semifinals.

Words from the Officials

Assistant coach João Martins, who led the team in Abel Ferreira's absence, highlighted the importance of defeating all opponents and the emotion brought by classic matches. He emphasized the need to keep working and pushing every day to maintain confidence and performance.

Historical Choque-Rei Records

Palmeiras established the second-longest unbeaten streak in Choque-Rei in the national tournament, second only to the 25 unbeaten matches between 1974 and 1999. The 'Verdão' also recorded seven consecutive victories, the best positive streak in the classic.

Upcoming Challenges

With their lead secured, Palmeiras faces Corinthians in the 27th round this Sunday, while São Paulo refocuses on the Sudamericana final against Boca Juniors on Tuesday. Both teams need focus and preparation for their upcoming commitments.

With information from UOL, ge.
